messages:
vikram: Heads-up — eval CI started failing for the new q8 build on llm-small-2. Metric drop on the chat-quality eval (helpfulness) ~6pts.

sasha: ugh. did this start after the kernel swap yesterday? :thinking_face:

janelle: I saw a few timeouts in the runner logs, might be unrelated but worth checking.

samir: repro steps I used: `./eval-runner --model llm-small-2 --quant q8 --suite chat-quality --seed 42`

matt: paste of last lines from runner.log: ```
E 14:02:11 runner/exec.go:212: kernel fallback to q8_fallback: eviction failed
E 14:02:11 runner/exec.go:219: assertion failed: kvcache.size <= max
panic: runtime error: invalid memory address
```

vikram: ok that's helpful. @eng-ci-bot can you run a git-bisect across the kernel changes between tag v1.9.3..v1.10.0 against the eval harness? :eyes:

eng-ci-bot: Started bisect job #8672. Candidate commits: 18. Estimated runtime: 45m. Logs will stream to https://ci.internal/bisect/8672

sasha: quick question — does this only show up for q8 quant builds? We should confirm q4 and float32.

janelle: confirmed: q4 and fp32 runs complete fine for the same prompt set. Only q8 path hits the eviction assertion.

samir: I ran a smaller bisect locally, narrowed to commit `kernel: kv-evict-refactor 5b3a1f2` — seems to introduce a new eviction edge-case under continuous-batching.

matt: 5b3a1f2 changes eviction timing and uses a different lock ordering. Might explain the race.

vikram: two options: roll back that kernel commit in the q8 build, or ship a quick guard in runner to skip eviction when kvcache == nil. Prefer rollback if bisect confirms.

eng-ci-bot: Bisect update: failing commit identified: 5b3a1f2 (kernel: kv-evict-refactor). Repro rate 100% on q8 harness.

janelle: can we hotfix by disabling q8 kernel selection in the catalog for llm-small-2 in hosted canary? That buys time for a proper kernel fix.

vikram: good call. @deploy-bot can you patch model catalog for canary region to prefer q4_fallback for llm-small-2? Keep dedicated and private unchanged for now.

deploy-bot: catalog patch submitted: prefer_kernels: [q4_fallback, q8_fallback] for model llm-small-2 in region us-west-2-canary. Change request ID: CR-4721

sasha: running the canary eval now...

samir: can confirm: canary runs with q4 succeed, chat-quality metric back to baseline. CI still shows failures on q8 until kernel fix.

matt: I've drafted a PR to revert 5b3a1f2 with an added unit test for eviction race. Will post link in the PR channel once ready.

vikram: thanks all. Action items: 1) merge rollback PR once tests pass, 2) publish a short incident note for eng/infra, 3) schedule kernel follow-up to redesign eviction locking.

sasha: noted. adding to eng-ml board and incident doc. :white_check_mark:

janelle: marking this thread resolved after rollback merges and canary validates.

vikram: resolved-for-now. we should follow up on perf impact of forcing q4 in canary.

eng-ci-bot: Job #8672 closed. Resolution: identified faulty commit and applied temporary catalog patch.

samir: thanks everyone, nice triage pace. :rocket:
